reason: The public historical deposit is exceptionally valuable for immutable launch provenance, creator/self-buy, outside-buyer, buyout, metadata-hash and operator/funder research. Current website terms changed after the deposit and must not be silently treated as identical to the earlier CC0 release.

frozen_public_deposit.permitted_research_role: bulk historical internal research subject to the frozen deposit's license and provenance

live_site_and_api.observed_change: Interim terms effective 2026-09-13 distinguish previously released CC0 copies from API/licensed data and state that licensed data may not be redistributed in bulk or accessed by working around quotas.
live_site_and_api.framework_rule: Do not assume current live API/bulk data inherits the old CC0 terms. Verify current terms before any automated live integration, use normal documented access only, and never work around quotas.

research_findings: Launch-time metadata is itself perishable. A 2026-09-12 report re-fetched launch documents byte-for-byte and found host-dependent survival; historical capture therefore has genuine provenance/lore value beyond present-tense URLs.
Image and metadata SHA-256 reuse across launches can support copycat/lore originality research without semantic guessing.
Operator/funder groups are valuable network evidence but the source explicitly warns that common-funder infrastructure can also be a trading terminal; shared funder alone is not common-control proof.

The source reports a dated negative experiment: 19,412 simulated bonding-curve positions in a favorable organic subset during September 2026 produced zero 5x outcomes. Treat this as a regime-specific falsifier and replicate independently before changing tail priors.
anti_overclaim: A clean launch record is not a positive alpha signal.
A finding is not proof of fraud or intent.
Current pool balance is mutable and must carry observation age.
Receipt/decode timestamps are not always exact block-time ordering inside a batch.
Rebuilt and late-discovery records must not be mixed with live-observed records without an explicit cohort flag.
